data.notes: December 2026 is already showing a strong Detty December spine, but many artist lineups remain unannounced this early, so this calendar favors dated, source-confirmed festivals and flagship concerts.

events.title: United World Music & Film Festival
events.venueName: Accra International Conference Centre & Black Star Square
events.summary: A four-day music, film, culture, business and innovation festival in Accra, with published daily programming including live concert kickoffs, evening concert series, a “Night of Legends” concert and a closing concert.

events.title: ALIV FEST 2026
events.summary: An 18-night Accra carnival-style destination experience with one main stage, live music performances, DJs and peak-night Afrobeats and Amapiano programming from Thursday through Sunday.

events.title: Black Sherif Zaama Disco Concert
events.summary: AccraEvents lists Black Sherif’s Zaama Disco Concert for December 21, 2026, describing it as an immersive production with lights, visuals and performers from across West Africa.

events.title: BHIM Festival
events.summary: Stonebwoy’s BHIM Festival is listed for December 24, 2026, at Accra Sports Stadium, with a focus on Afro-Dancehall, Afrobeats, Reggae, Highlife and Dancehall traditions.

events.title: Rapperholic
events.summary: Sarkodie’s annual Rapperholic concert is listed for Christmas Day 2026 in Accra, continuing one of Ghana’s signature year-end hip-hop concert brands.

events.title: Afro-GoGo Festival
events.summary: A six-day diaspora homecoming festival in Accra with live performances, DJ sets, rooftop parties, a beach party and a Go-Go x NYE finale. The music program highlights Go-Go alongside Afrobeats, Highlife, Reggae, Jazz, R&B, Amapiano and Hip-Hop influences.

events.title: Detty Rave
events.summary: Detty Rave is confirmed for December 27, 2026, on Spintex Road, with AccraEvents describing it as a high-energy end-of-year celebration blending African music, fashion, art and culture.

events.title: AfroFuture
events.summary: AfroFuture is listed for December 28–29, 2026, at El Wak Stadium, with live performances, DJs, art, food and fashion as part of Accra’s peak Detty December window.

events.title: Promiseland Concert
events.summary: Promiseland Concert is listed for December 30, 2026, on Spintex Road; the listing confirms a music-and-culture concert format, though the 2026 supporting lineup is not yet published there.
